eips.title: Quick Slots
eips.summary: Whether quick slots belongs in heze-devnet-2 and on the main Heze spec branch; no consensus, kept on a feature branch.

moments.context: Jihoon said no release had been cut because the discussion was contentious and it was decided not to include quick slots in heze-devnet-2.
Potuz asked whether quick slots is in the devnet scope or not; Justin Traglia argued against, Barnabas argued for, Matthew Keil sided with Justin.
Justin's reasons against: a new release would be needed, and it would be harder for clients without quick slots support to join devnet 2 at a different slot duration.
Jihoon offered to open a PR putting quick slots on a feature branch based on the latest Heze spec, with test vectors clients can pull in.
Justin said quick slots should stay on a feature branch for at least another month, until after Devcon.

eips.title: Disallow new 0x00 validators
eips.summary: Barnabas proposed changing EIP-8365 to make new 0x00 validators inactive instead of burning deposited ETH.

moments.context: NC asked in chat whether 8365 and 8015 should also be on feature branches; potuz suggested SFI-ing them at the next ACD call.

Barnabas raised wanting a change to the existing EIP disallowing 0x00 deposits, proposing inactive status instead of burning ETH. Discussion ensued about spec complexity, with NC and Nico noting the current spec is simpler, and Barnabas arguing burning ETH for a previously valid operation is unacceptable. NC opened a draft PR for an alternative guard placement. The group agreed to bring this to ACDC.

eips.title: Remove `deposit` and `eth1data` fields
eips.summary: NC asked in chat whether EIP-8015 should also be treated like the quick slots feature branch discussion.

moments.context: NC asked in chat whether the two smaller EIPs, 8365 and 8015, should also be on feature branches or pulled from Heze; potuz said not to pull anything already passing test vectors.
